name: Local Implicit Ray Function (LIRF)
definition: A generalizable radiance field representation that predicts volumetric radiance fields from multi-view images using local image features, conical frustum sampling, visibility estimation, and transformer-based aggregation to handle occlusions and scale variations.
summary: LIRF is a generalizable radiance field that predicts volumetric fields from multi-view images by aggregating local features via transformer attention and conical frustum sampling to handle occlusions and scale variations.
